profile_text.body:
Speechmatics is a speech technology company founded in 2006 and headquartered in Cambridge, UK. The company describes itself as building speech-to-text APIs designed for real conversations rather than controlled demos, with support for accents, multiple speakers, and multilingual speech across more than 55 languages. Its stated use cases include live captions, voice agents, meeting notes, and contact center analytics across international markets.

The company's core offering is a speech-to-text API that can process both recorded files and live audio, returning transcripts for captions, search, analytics, records, and voice AI applications. Speechmatics also offers text-to-speech capability and describes a multilingual model called Melia 1, which it says runs at less than half the mixed error rate of the next best model on Arabic and English, and switches more accurately than competing models on Mandarin and Tamil. A separate speech-to-text model called Linden, described as built for voice agents, is available through LiveKit Inference. The site notes UK hosting and GDPR compliance as part of its product positioning.

The held facts confirm Speechmatics has a tracked product in the voice and audio category, noted for speech-to-text, real-time translation, accent-agnostic processing, UK hosting, and GDPR compliance. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
